quote: On September 2, local time, the EGD Highway Project in Guyana, which China TIESIJU Civil Engineering Group built, was officially opened to traffic… EGD Highway Project is located in the fourth district of Georgetown… starts from Eccles on the east bank of Demailala and ends at Great Diamond… The total length of the 9th bid constructed by The First Engineering Bureau of CREC is 680 meters
note: Opened CREC EGD Highway Bid 9 opening primary (CapEx blank).
